map.：U = sigma^2/(2E) = 1/2 * sigma * epsilo: : U = sigma^2/(2E) = 1/2 * sigma * epsilon. Steel at 200 MPa, E=200 GPa: U = (200e6)^2/(2*200e9) = 100 J/m3. Fully released on unloading.
map.：E 大储能密度低（硬而脆储不了多少）；橡胶 E 小但可大变形，总储能可观。: : Large E means low storage density (hard and brittle stores little); rubber has small E but large deformation, total storage substantial.

map.弹性能和塑性功区别？: Difference between elastic energy and plastic work?
map.弹性能在卸载时完全释放（可逆），塑性功转为热与缺陷（不可逆）；冲击吸能设计要分清: Elastic energy fully releases on unloading (reversible); plastic work turns to heat and defects (irreversible); impact energy absorption design must distinguish them.
